notes: 영어 녹음 대본. text = 한국어 열쇠(NARRATION_CLIPS_EN 키), segs 의 글은 영어만(한글·연기 지시 넣지 않음, 2026-11-25 오류). 목소리는 voice_script_el.json 과 같다.

lines.text: 크리스마스이브예요. 초록 나무 아래서 잔치가 열렸어요.
lines.en: It was Christmas Eve. There was a party around the green tree.
segs: It was Christmas Eve. There was a party around the green tree.

lines.en: Godfather's here!
Merry Christmas, children.
Clara, this present is for you.
segs: Clara, this present is for you.

lines.en: Tap the present to open it.
segs: Tap the present to open it.

lines.text: 호두 껍데기를 톡 깨 주는 인형이야.
lines.en: This little doll can crack a nut for you.
segs: This little doll can crack a nut for you.

lines.en: Hello! Want to sit by me?
segs: Hello! Want to sit by me?

lines.text: 이 큰 호두도 깰 수 있을까?
lines.en: Can he crack this big nut, too?
segs: Can he crack this big nut, too?

lines.en: Oh! His jaw came loose!
I pushed too hard. I'm sorry.
segs: I pushed too hard. I'm sorry.

lines.en: Hold still. I'll wrap up your jaw.
segs: Hold still. I'll wrap up your jaw.

lines.en: Find the blue scarf that matches his hatband.
segs: Find the blue scarf that matches his hatband.

lines.en: The blues match!
That one's yellow. His hatband is blue.
segs: That one's yellow. His hatband is blue.

lines.en: Now you can rest beside me.
segs: Now you can rest beside me.

lines.text: 인형은 바구니에, 클라라는 그 곁 의자에 포근히 누웠어요.
lines.en: The doll lay snug in his basket. Clara curled up in the chair beside him.
segs: The doll lay snug in his basket. Clara curled up in the chair beside him.

lines.en: At midnight, the clock went bong.
segs: At midnight, the clock went bong.

lines.en: Oh! The tree can almost touch the ceiling!
segs: Oh! The tree can almost touch the ceiling!

lines.en: Clara, it's me!

lines.text: 바스락. 왕관을 쓴 생쥐가 코를 내밀었어요.
lines.en: Rustle, rustle. A mouse in a crown poked out his nose.
segs: Rustle, rustle. A mouse in a crown poked out his nose.

lines.en: Squeak! We came to the party, too!
segs: Squeak! We came to the party, too!

lines.en: Soldiers, line up!
There's no room to get out! I'll help you!
segs: There's no room to get out! I'll help you!

lines.en: Tap the slipper.
Whoops! Back home!

lines.text: 작은 꼬리들이 우르르, 구멍 속으로 쏙!
lines.en: Off they went, little tails whisking into the hole!
segs: Off they went, little tails whisking into the hole!

lines.en: Thank you for helping me, Clara.
segs: Thank you for helping me, Clara.

lines.en: Oh, a prince! You're wearing my scarf!
segs: Oh, a prince! You're wearing my scarf!

lines.text: 응, 나야. 함께 과자 나라에 갈래?
lines.en: Yes, it's me. Shall we visit the Land of Sweets?
segs: Yes, it's me. Shall we visit the Land of Sweets?

lines.en: Let's go!
A snowy path opened between the branches.
segs: A snowy path opened between the branches.

lines.en: Take my hand. Let's cross the bridge.
segs: Take my hand. Let's cross the bridge.

lines.text: 다리 위에 앉은 눈송이를 톡 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Tap the snowflake on the bridge.
segs: Tap the snowflake on the bridge.

lines.en: Yes, it landed on the bridge!
segs: Yes, it landed on the bridge!

lines.en: That's under the bridge. Let's look up.
segs: That's under the bridge. Let's look up.

lines.en: A snowflake landed on my hand!
segs: A snowflake landed on my hand!

lines.en: Through that gate is the Land of Sweets.
segs: Through that gate is the Land of Sweets.

lines.en: Welcome! This dance is for you.
segs: Welcome! This dance is for you.

lines.en: Round and round. The flowers are dancing, too!
segs: Round and round. The flowers are dancing, too!

lines.en: The last petal gently folded up.
segs: The last petal gently folded up.

lines.text: 창으로 아침 햇살이 들어왔어요. 클라라가 눈을 떴어요.
lines.en: Morning light came through the window. Clara opened her eyes.
segs: Morning light came through the window. Clara opened her eyes.

lines.text: 여기 있었구나. 좋은 아침, 호두까기 인형아.
lines.en: There you are. Good morning, Nutcracker.
segs: There you are. Good morning, Nutcracker.
